events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: Reigning MVP Patrick Mahomes injured his right knee in a pileup near the goal line before his Kansas City teammates rallied around their fallen superstar for a 30-6 thrashing of Denver on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patrick Mahomes hurts knee in Chiefs' win over Broncos

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: Jared Goff threw for two touchdowns and ran for another, and the Los Angeles Rams returned to the site of last season's Super Bowl loss to beat the reeling Atlanta Falcons 37-10 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams snap skid by beating Falcons 37-10 as Ryan hurts ankle

headlines.description: Tre'Davious White forced two second-half turnovers, Micah Hyde returned an onside kick for a touchdown, and the Buffalo Bills rallied from a five-point deficit for a 31-21 victory over the winless Miami Dolphins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills D delivers in 31-21 victory over winless Dolphins

headlines.description: Gardner Minshew led a fourth-quarter touchdown drive that put Jacksonville ahead to stay Sunday, and Yannick Ngakoue returned an interception 23 yards to clinch a 27-17 victory over the winless Cincinnati Bengals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Minshew, defense lead Jaguars over winless Bengals 27-17

headlines.description: Kirk Cousins matched a career high with four touchdown passes, leading the surging Minnesota Vikings to a 42-30 win over the slumping Detroit Lions on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cousins has 4 TD passes as Vikings surge past Lions 42-30

events.name: Oakland Raiders at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers had his best game by far under new Packers coach Matt LaFleur, throwing for 429 yards and five touchdowns and running for another as Green Bay beat the Oakland Raiders 42-24 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers throws 5 TD passes, Packers gash Raiders 42-24

headlines.description: Jacoby Brissett threw a career-high four touchdown passes Sunday and the Indianapolis Colts sealed a 30-23 victory over the Houston Texans with Darius Leonard's late interception.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colts take AFC South lead with 30-23 victory over Texans

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at New York Giants

headlines.description: Chase Edmonds rushed for career highs of 126 yards and three touchdowns, overshadowing the return of Giants star running back Saquon Barkley in the Arizona Cardinals' 27-21 victory over New York on a soggy Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Edmonds runs for 3 TDs, Cards top Giants in Barkley's return

headlines.description: Robbie Gould made field goals from 28, 22 and 29 yards to provide the only points in an ugly 9-0 win by the San Francisco 49ers over the Washington Redskins in steady rain and driving wind Sunday to remain undefeated.
headlines.shortLinkText: 49ers beat Redskins in ugly 9-0 game to improve to 6-0

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: Jurrell Casey recovered a fumble by Melvin Gordon at the goal line with 15 seconds left, and the Tennessee Titans pulled out a 23-20 victory Sunday over the Los Angeles Chargers after a frantic finish.
headlines.shortLinkText: Casey recovers fumble, Titans hold off Chargers' rally 23-20

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: Teddy Bridgewater threw for 281 yards and two touchdowns, and the New Orleans Saints improved to 5-0 without injured starter Drew Brees with a 36-25 victory over the Chicago Bears on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bridgewater throws for 2 TDs, surging Saints top Bears 36-25

headlines.description: Whether it was scrambling away from trouble or designed runs to use his speed, there was no stopping Lamar Jackson.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jackson's legs, Ravens defense roll past Seahawks 30-16

headlines.description: Ezekiel Elliott ran over safety Malcolm Jenkins on his way to 111 yards and a touchdown, Dak Prescott threw an easy scoring pass on a great fake to his star running back before a TD run and the Cowboys rolled to a 37-10 victory over the Philadelphia...
headlines.shortLinkText: Cowboys run over Eagles, take 1st in NFC East with 37-10 win

events.name: New England Patriots at New York Jets

headlines.description: Tom Brady set the tone with a long slice-and-dice touchdown drive, New England's blitz-happy defense forced Sam Darnold into five turnovers and the Patriots remained undefeated by cruising to a 33-0 victory over the New York Jets on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots blitz Darnold, Jets 33-0 to remain undefeated
